config.expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, accel_step reaches required_margin at or after the first val_mse_ratio < 1. Or the margin never reaches 0.15 within 300 steps, so the ordering depends on the threshold. Or the force margin is >= required_margin at some checkpoint in steps 5-50 in at least 2 seeds, which would mean the early force transient is real.
config.expected_if_true: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, accel_step first reaches margin >= required_margin at a checkpoint strictly before the first val_mse_ratio < 1. The accel_step margin reaches >= 0.15 before the step where val_mse_ratio first falls below 1, in at least 2 seeds. With 5 controls, the force margin stays below required_margin at every checkpoint from 5 to 50 in at least 2 seeds.
config.hypothesis: At N=64 the accel_step margin over the best-of-5 random controls reaches the required margin before the first checkpoint where val_mse_ratio < 1, even with a stricter 0.15 threshold. The force margin spike at steps 5-25 is a control artifact, not a short-lived learned feature.
